info.title: Lupira Location API
info.description: Location and presence backend for Lupira. Authenticate with a Bearer token issued by the OIDC provider (Authentik).

get.summary: The caller's resolved local identity (JIT-provisioned on first login).
List the caller's registered location-tracking devices.

post.summary: Register a device; returns the one-time ingest API key.

delete.summary: Retire a device (revokes its ingest keys).

post.summary: Ingest a batch of GPS fixes (NDJSON, one fix per line).

get.summary: The device's resume cursor (last accepted seq + ts).
Whether tracking is paused for this device (the uploader should stop collecting if so).
Raw track over a time range (capped).
Server-downsampled track (one best-accuracy fix per time bucket).
Distance + speed stats over a time range.
Fixes within a lat/lon rectangle over a time range.
Coarse place label at a time (synergy-safe — never the raw fix).
Materialized stay-points over a time range.
Materialized trips over a time range.

delete.summary: Purge raw fixes + derived docs in a time range (owner erase).

post.summary: Pause tracking for a device (ingest is discarded while paused).

DeviceKind.description: Kind of registered device that feeds location telemetry.

IngestReject.description: A per-row rejection within an otherwise-accepted batch (permanent — the uploader should drop + log it).

LocationCursor.description: The resume cursor for a device: the highest accepted seq + its timestamp (from the latest-snapshot table).

LocationIngestReceipt.description:
The outcome of a location ingest batch. Idempotent re-uploads show up as int LocationIngestReceipt.Duplicates; the
            uploader advances past long? LocationIngestReceipt.HighWaterSeq. When tracking is paused the body is discarded and
            bool LocationIngestReceipt.Paused is true.

fromVisitId.description:
Endpoint visits (when the trip started/ended at a detected stay-point) — lets a client join trips to
            visit markers without time-window heuristics. The trip carries no geometry; fetch the polyline via
            GET /location/track/thinned for [StartTs, EndTs].

MeDto.description: The resolved local identity of the caller.

PauseTrackingRequest.description: Pause tracking for a device (optional human-readable reason).

PlaceLabelAtDto.description: A coarse "where was I at T" answer — a place label + coarsened coordinate, never the raw fix. Synergy-safe.

RegisterDeviceRequest.description: Register a device that will feed location telemetry.

RegisterDeviceResponse.description:
Result of registering a device. string RegisterDeviceResponse.ApiKey is the one-time plaintext ingest credential
            (`{keyId:N}.{secret}`) — it is shown only here and never retrievable again; only its hash is stored.

TrackPointDto.description: A point on a (raw or thinned) track.

TrackStatsDto.description: Distance + speed stats over a time range.

VisitedPlaceDto.description: A place visited on a day, with dwell minutes.

Bearer.description: OIDC bearer token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
